create_SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF: create a SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF distribution from log potentials for projective dependency parsing
run_SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF_argmax_and: run argmax_and_max on a SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF to find the highest-scoring dependency tree structure
sample_SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF: sample from a SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF distribution to generate random projective dependency trees
compute_SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF_margin: compute marginals for a SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF to get edge probabilities over all valid dependency trees
compute_SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF_top_k: compute top_k structures and scores from a SpanningTreeProjectiveCRF for the highest-scoring dependency trees
